protocol.note: p.3: with LOAD high, DATA is shifted on each CLK falling edge (CLK low between bytes, Figures 3-4 -> mode 1); LOAD pulsed low latches the 12-bit word into the selected DAC. LOAD is the active-high frame pin: the last 12 bits before LOAD falls are decoded (leading don't-care bits of the 16-clock transfers are skipped)

ldac.note: LDAC low: the selected DAC output updates when LOAD falls; LDAC high: values held until LDAC is pulsed low (p.3)
